summary: The diff adds a migration module (backend/migration.mo) with JEE-style questions and modifies backend/main.mo to use migration-based initialization. The main.mo initializes puzzles as an empty map and relies on Migration.run. The migration.mo content is truncated at question index 18, making it impossible to confirm all 25 questions are present. Questions are placed in a separate file rather than directly in main.mo as the constraint requires.
